description.zh-CN: 代码插件示例：给导出管线加一条规则——文件名只许 ASCII 安全字符（创意工坊上传与部分工具会被中文 / 空格绊倒）、单文件超过上限告警、没有封面告警。阈值存在插件私有设置里。
description.en: Code plugin example: adds an export rule — file names must be ASCII-safe (Workshop uploads and some tools trip over spaces / non-ASCII), oversized single files warn, missing preview warns. Thresholds live in the plugin's private settings.
